A free, open-source IPTV player for Android TV, Fire TV and phones. It\'s a player only — it doesn\'t supply channels; you connect the service you already pay for. Nothing you enter leaves your device except to talk to your own provider.

OpenTV is developed openly, with AI doing a large share of the coding under human direction — that\'s stated plainly, not hidden. Because it\'s open source, no single person going away can take it down: anyone can read every line, build it, and carry it on.

OpenTV is free and always will be — nothing is gated. If it\'s useful and you\'d like to chip in, GitHub Sponsors or a one-off tip keeps the updates coming: new features, fixes and support all come out of spare evenings. Entirely optional, and genuinely appreciated.
